title: ospf-neighbors
description: OSPF adjacencies the device reports, one row per neighbour. As with BGP, the identity is the neighbour's router-id rather than the address the adjacency runs over.

address.description: The neighbour's address on the shared link.

port.description: The reporting device's own interface the adjacency runs over.

state.description: Adjacency state, such as full or 2-way.
